inputs.checklistItemText: Trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment lack required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment)
inputs.question: On the landscape plan details (Sheet 37), are there any notes, details, or specifications for root barriers around underground electrical equipment locations? Look for details indicating root barrier depth and distance from equipment.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether root barrier specifications and notes exist on the plan details sheet—a document/note presence and readout question—rather than asking to measure actual distances or depths of root barriers. This is a progressive verification step (checking for specification presence) before any measurement or clearance verification would occur.
